title: The view from above
idea: Picture your situation from far above: the city, the country, the planet, the centuries. Your worry shrinks to its true size.
apply: When a problem feels huge, zoom out in steps: this week, this year, this lifetime. Then act on what is left.
remind: Zoom out. The problem gets its true size.
who: Nora, a nervous first-time manager the night before a big review.

scenes.nar: Nora has her first big review at nine tomorrow. She keeps replaying every possible slip, and she cannot stop checking her slides.

scenes.cap: is taking up her entire mind
scenes.sub: It feels like the whole world.
scenes.nar: One meeting has swallowed her whole mind. From where she sits, it feels like the entire world depends on it.

items.x: This year: one review of many
This life: a small dot in a long story

scenes.nar: Marcus Aurelius suggested looking from above. This week, it is one busy day. This year, it is one review of many. In a lifetime, it is a small dot.

items.x: Checked the slides one last time

scenes.nar: The meeting still matters, but now at its true size. She checks her slides once more, takes a walk, and sleeps.
